sourceFile: 49. BRS-161016  Report test VP dry temperature 150 for 1 hour to  improve VP bending date 09.07.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid comparable rows but mislabels the primary change and includes invalid auto measurement outcomes.
issues: Primary change should be dry VP 150°C for 1 hour vs normal VP, not mold list vs normal.
VP mold numbers should be subgroup keys paired with each normal/test row.
Measurement outcomes are header-derived aggregates and not citeable comparisons.
Decision rows 71 and 75-77 are important but not cited in case evidence.
Changed-factor domain is overbroad; evidence supports process condition with mold subgroup context.
correctionPlan: Set baseline to Normal VP lot date 3/7 and changed condition to Test dry 1 hour at 150°C, lot date 6/7 where shown.
Move VP mold #2,#3,#6,#7,#8,#9,#10 into subgroup keys and preserve date, line, lot, and process step.
Keep laser cutting/bending NG rate and function NG rate as outcomes under one review case.
Remove measurement-1 through measurement-4 unless rebuilt from real row-level numeric comparisons.
Add decision/conclusion rows 71 and 75-77 as supporting evidence.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations for comparison data are sufficient, but citations need corrected grouping and conclusion rows.
